name: Ruth Floyd

relationships.evidence: Pelletreau Floyd family: children of Nicoll Floyd & Tabitha Smith: Ruth (b. 2 Feb 1731, m. Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull), William (signer)...

bioAdditions: Daughter of Nicoll Floyd and Tabitha, daughter of Jonathan Smith 2d (S1), so a Bull Smith descendant: Bull -> Jonathan -> Jonathan 2d -> Tabitha -> Ruth, 4 generations: 3rd cousin 8 times removed. Sister of the signer William Floyd and wife of Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Pelletreau gives each generation; same dependency on the Temperance Smith link as all Bull Smith cousins.

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 465, 486
